in_hebrew.name: רָעַיָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word 'ra'ah' meaning 'see' or 'behold'. 'Ra'ay-ah' could mean 'she saw joy' or 'she beheld joy'. This meaning fits well with the name 'Reine' as it sounds joyful and regal.

in_greek.name: Ρεινη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Reine' is derived from the Greek word 'reina' meaning 'queen' or 'regal one'. This meaning fits well with the name as it sounds royal and majestic.

in_latin.name: Regina
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Regina' is derived from the Latin word 'regina' meaning 'queen'. This meaning fits well with the name 'Reine' as it also has a regal sound and meaning.
